notes.title: The rumbly update! (1.1.1)
notes.notes:
Here comes a small patch fixing a few bugs and adding vibration support for gamepads and the steamdeck!

Patchnotes:

 Removed the ability to spawn a storm on top of another storm. This could cause a crash if it causes the player to infinitely move back and forth. (Thanks to "A Stick In A Can" for reporting it!)
 Added rumble/vibration when playing with gamepads (and a setting to turn it off). This works great with my old xbox controller, but sadly it seems like the rumble capabilities of the steam deck are very weak in comparison. This was something I missed when doing the gamepad update, so I'm glad it's in the game now!
 Added sound effect for killing a lurker by dragging it out of it's weeds
 Fixed the "A" button hint on end turn being visible even if using keyboard/mouse

That's all, if you have not reviewed the game yet, I would still love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A small update to adress some bugs with the totem dice and the auto exit button.

Patchnotes

 Fixed bug where the totem dice weren't placeable on the first turn in a new level if it was placed when exiting the last one.
 Fixed bug which caused the autoexit to missbehave if enabled while still moving
 Fixed bug where ghosts wouldn't move on repair/reroll actions of a totem dice
 Tweaked the totem area highlight texture for when you have upgraded range
 Removed secret debug cheatcode

I will also take this opportunity to leave a friendly reminder that if you have any opinions about the game, please leave a review as it helps future players and me!

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.notes:
This update adresses some minor (and some slightly bigger) bugs and brings an improved and longer music track for world 3

Patchnotes:

 The music track in world 3 has been updated to be longer and less repetitive.
 Fixed bug with the autoexit path not updating if you teleport
 Fixed a bug causing the pull dice upgrade to not do anything
 Fixed a bug causing the win screen to display "try again" instead of "next world" when completing world 2.
 Fixed a bug causing the grid display not to update when entering a new world.
 Started work on implementing controller support, (you will still need steam mouse emulation to be able to play though). Will finish it if there is a demand for it.

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.notes:
This update adds a credits screen along with some quality of life improvements such as a togglable grid and the ability to see the path autoexit will take.

Patchnotes:

 Added a Credits sceen accessible from a button in the main menu
 Added a grid overlay that togglable with "G"
 Added a dotted line that displays the path autoexit will take when you hover the autoexit button
 Added a hint to the quick press shortcut in the hotkeys menu
 Made it possible to move the camera when camera panning is turned of by holding the mouse at the edges of the screen.
 Updated the world 3 tileset slightly
 Updated the logo
 Updated the splash screen
 Fixed a most likely critical bug with the first boss
 Tweaked the first boss to be slightly easier
 Removed the hotkeys button from the main menu and made it accessible from a button in the pause menu in game.
 Fixed an issue with screen shake
